action.name: Rootform
action.description: Analyze or compare evidence, evaluate selected Policies, and present Rootform reports in GitHub

version.description: Exact published Rootform version; omit only to reuse an earlier Rootform Action step

github-token.description: Optional GitHub API token for release rate limits; root comment uses it only when enabled

project.description: Rootform project directory for raw evidence or Policy Pack selection; default workspace

locked.description: Require and preserve the project rootform.lock for analysis or Policy selection

offline.description: Prepare selected external content without network access

cache.description: Cache verified external Dialect and Policy Pack sources selected by the project lock

input.description: Plan JSON, state JSON, or saved Form file

plan-file.description: Optional saved binary plan paired with input; supplied pairing must verify

before.description: Before operand: plan JSON, state JSON, or single-input Form

after.description: After operand: plan JSON, state JSON, or single-input Form

before-plan-file.description: Optional saved plan paired with before; supplied pairing must verify

after-plan-file.description: Optional saved plan paired with after; supplied pairing must verify

stage.description: Architecture stage to present or evaluate: planned, refreshed, recorded

before-stage.description: Before architecture stage: planned, refreshed, recorded; CLI default when omitted

after-stage.description: After architecture stage: planned, refreshed, recorded; CLI default when omitted

side.description: Comparison sides to check: before, after, both; CLI default is both

policy.description: Policy selectors, one per line; narrows explicitly selected Policy Packs

policy-pack.description: Policy Pack source directories or compiled files, one path per line

check.description: Evaluate all project-selected Policies even without explicit selector or overlay

summary.description: Append CLI Markdown to GitHub Job Summary

upload-artifact.description: Persist only Form and derived reports as one GitHub artifact

artifact-name.description: Optional stable artifact name; default is unique per invocation, including matrix jobs

retention-days.description: Artifact retention from 1 to 90 days, subject to repository limit

comment.description: Opt in to one current same-repository PR comment; requires serialized reporter job and write permission

form.description: Reusable same-job path to the Form; compare returns a Comparison Form

report.description: Reusable same-job path to complete CLI Markdown report

html.description: Reusable same-job path to self-contained HTML Explorer

result.description: Reusable same-job path to Policy result JSON

sarif.description: Reusable same-job path to Policy result SARIF

exit-code.description: Exact Rootform check exit code, published before applying its gate

artifact-id.description: Uploaded GitHub artifact ID for cross-job download
